title: Lost Knowledge
description: The Circle has wanted the Amulet of Arcane Sight out of Willow Dale for three Archmages running, and Elara has never been the one to bring it home. She has heard, from a source she won't name, that somebody outside the Circle has started asking after Willow Dale too. Whoever reaches the amulet first keeps the credit - and if it isn't the Circle, that is a decades-long failure landing on Elara's watch specifically.

objectives.description: Get to Willow Dale before anyone else does
Get through the trap gauntlet three Archmages' searchers never cleared
objectives.notes: Use Detect Magic to reveal trap triggers

objectives.description: Put down the guardians still standing watch over it
Take the Amulet of Arcane Sight before whoever else is asking gets there
Bring it to Elara before anyone can say the Circle lost the race

notes: Threat: an unnamed outside party asking after the same ruin, racing the Circle for it. Giver motive: three Archmages before Elara have failed to bring this amulet home, and losing it to an outsider now would be her failure specifically, in front of a council that remembers the other three. Consequence: unwired - there is no rival encounter in the data, so the race is stated in prose only. Final Apprentice quest, promotion to Journeyman.
